name: Hand Wash Bottle
tagline: A faceted hand wash dispenser bottle in two colorways, modeled in 3D from the supplied product photos. Verified LIMEX composition data is in progress.
description: A hand wash dispenser bottle with a distinctive elongated diamond mould pattern and a black pump head, produced in white and green colorways. The interactive 3D model shows both variants side by side and is photo-matched to the supplied reference photography, including the quilted facet geometry, matte pump finish and colors. Verified LIMEX composition and supplier spec data for this product are in progress - no figures are published until confirmed.
